# A09-S120: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

So I got the pictures opened. My event colleagues (..who put things on the website) complain if the files are smaller than one megabyte. Your pictures are under 400 kilobytes, so they will not look good on the website.

An ordinary picture taken on a mobile phone is often over one megabyte. Do you have the possibility to take a picture of yourself e.g. with t-shirt and cap and send? Sorry it has to be so complicated.

[…]
